## Description {#details}

<p>This file builds on the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/graphtraits-h">ADT/GraphTraits.h</a> file to build a generic graph post order iterator.</p>


<p>This should work over any graph type that has a GraphTraits specialization.</p>
